name: Ichigaya Byakko
source:
One of Bit's partners, a fox-eared girl.

In reality, it's actually Byakko, one of Tabito's classmates who plays with a female avatar.

Putting his knowledge of VR environments and programming to good use, he helps Tabito obtain victory by acting as his race engineer and advisor.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2983260/LUNARiA_Virtualized_Moonchild/]Steam[/url]]
